translations.title: The Inmate
translations.overview: A former U.S. Marine, Lázaro Mendoza, enters a maximum security prison in Mexico (La Rotunda), under a false identity and accused of an alleged triple murder. Now as Dante Pardo, his mission is to infiltrate a dangerous band of inmates and guards that operate inside and outside of prison who are the prime suspects of the kidnapping of the teenage daughter of U.S. Judge, John Morris. Inside La Rotunda, Lázaro has to find out who carried out the kidnapping and the whereabouts of the girl.

La serie está protagonizada por Ignacio Serricchio y Ana Claudia Talancón y cuenta la historia de un ex marino que ingresa en una prisión de máxima seguridad en la frontera entre México y Estados Unidos para investigar el secuestro de Linda Morris, interpretada por Isabella Castillo4​, la hija de un prominente juez estadounidense.
